newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NZ SPORT, RUGBY UNION - Lomu to complete treatment this week.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT, RUGBY UNION - Lomu to complete treatment this week.

text.p: MELBOURNE, July 27 - Jonah Lomu, forced out of rugby with a kidney ailment, completes his treatment on Tuesday, All Black coach John Hart said.
Lomu and Michael Jones, who is recovering from a knee surgery, met the All Blacks in their dressing room after Saturday night's 33-18 win over Australia at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
"He should start training in four to five weeks. I'm looking forward to taking him on the tour of Britain at the end of the year," Hart said after speaking to the blockbusting winger.
The four or five weeks' wait before returning to rugby is to allow the drugs he has been taking to drain out of his system.
"He's been training and he's very, very keen," Hart said.
